credits.title: The Last Flag
credits.overview: After Indonesia became independent, a veteran independence soldier, Ki Atam, continued his life selling banana blossoms for a meager income, he lived a life full of poverty. Approaching the anniversary of Independence Day, he wanted to buy an Indonesian national flag for his house. However, a tragedy befell him.

credits.title: Jani Be Good
credits.overview: Ten days after her sister Julia leaves home without a word, Jani (13) wants only one thing: her return. Jani knows her mother, Winnie, is the reason Julia left, and the two are growing distant while Winnie buries her guilt in work. Only Oma, the grandmother, comforts Jani.
